test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

TIDE : URBW :: BACK : CZAQ :: WORD : ?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **First alphabet is increased to 1 positional value.

 Second alphabet is coded as the alphabet with opposite positional value.

 **Third alphabet is decreased to 2 positional value.

** **Fourth alphabet is coded as the alphabet with opposite positional value +1.** **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30d4329bb55377a473391e0ba8b05ecdb4075bef26f43c867f62983186762162.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1eccc6470c1192674924e09c4140135c4e9377cb0ff8bd567c8696695a1b247e.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8e675c3abe30bcb536b195425d16a47d8ffa692891c8936ba80c0c5cd3db2f5.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 1) **
